q.g: In this quest you first have to take a blood sample from the dead worker on Factory, which is located inside the "Med Tent Gate" extraction. A Factory emergency exit key is required to enter it. Then you have to stash the sample in Sanitar's room in The Lab. The room is located on the second floor, directly across from the laboratory block (G22) and requires a Keycard with a blue marking to enter.
